set.acceptance: A test pages a roadmap whose group is split by --limit and sees the group's kind and intent repeated on the next page, with every (group, change set) entry appearing exactly once across the pages, so a change set that serves two milestones appears once in each of its two groups; --all matches the concatenated pages; a bad cursor and an out-of-range limit exit 2; a roadmap of more than 100 change sets is read whole by health's roadmap check; roadmap --json and api call roadmap print the same bytes; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
set.statement: rhiza roadmap pages its change sets in group order (milestones, then backlog, then umbrellas; depends-on order within a group) with --limit, --cursor and --all; a page holds only the groups with change sets on it, a group split across pages repeats its kind and intent, and health's roadmap check reads it with all
